primary_sources.role: official H I measurement and public moment-map release

score_contract.common_mask: finite MOM1 and positive finite MOM2 intersected with the fixed four-model numerical and source eligibility for that source-resolution cell
score_contract.primary_metric: unweighted common-pixel velocity RMSE using the shared sign and shared systemic velocity
score_contract.primary_replication_rule: RG must have strictly smaller primary-cell RMSE than Newton, RAR, and standard MOND
score_contract.rotation_sign: one observed major-axis covariance sign per resolution computed on the nuisance-reference-cell common mask and shared by all candidates and all source cells
score_contract.shared_systemic_velocity: one observed MOM1 mean per resolution computed on the nuisance-reference-cell common mask and shared by all candidates and all source cells
